pure-announcement.rationale: This is a walkthrough of the OTel GenAI semantic conventions using already-shipped tools, not a launch, release note or funding post.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover MCP mechanics, proxy-boundary capture, SIEM gaps and evals; none records the gen_ai.* span, metric and content-capture conventions.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Claims are checkable against the linked semconv spec, the vendor telemetry docs, and a reproducible local Aspire Dashboard setup.

durability.rationale: The standardized-GenAI-telemetry mechanism ages well, but the note leans on a current tool-support matrix, Copilot setting keys and conventions it itself says are under active development.

actionability.rationale: It tells a builder exactly which standard attributes and histograms to emit (gen_ai.request.model, token/duration histograms) and that content capture is off by default — decisions that apply to any GenAI app, not just the demo tools.

atomicity.rationale: One idea — LLM-call observability via the GenAI semantic conventions — carried through a single walkthrough whose demo steps support rather than dilute it.
